### SHINE
Author: Van Walton
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-july-13-2009-11605893.html
Passage: Daniel 12:3
Points:
- Believers often ask God for detailed, step-by-step instructions before making life decisions.
- God's primary will does not depend on a specific geographic location or career path.
- Wherever Christians find themselves, they are called to love people and point them to God.
- Instead of waiting for exhaustive details, believers are summoned simply to shine His light.

### Lie Back and Look Up
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/today-s-insight-january-1-2018.html
Passage: Daniel 12:3
Points:
- Gazing at the starry expanse reveals the breathtaking scale and glory of God's creation.
- The unfathomable distances across the universe demonstrate divine majesty and order.
- The intricate, synchronized motion of the cosmos points directly to God rather than chance.
- Contemplating the grandeur of the heavens turns human wonder into humility and prayer.
